# PGKhata - Free PG Management Software

## Overview
PGKhata is a free, web-based PG (Paying Guest) management software for Indian PG owners. It helps manage properties, tenants, billing, and communications.

## Key Features
- Multi-property management
- Tenant management with approval workflow
- Auto bill generation with line-item billing
- WhatsApp notifications for bills and reminders
- Expense tracking with categories
- Police verification tracking
- Staff management with role-based permissions
- Reports and analytics

## Pricing
PGKhata is 100% free forever. No hidden charges, no premium tiers, no per-tenant fees.

## Technology
- Web-based application (no installation required)
- WhatsApp Business API integration
- Cloudflare R2 for document storage
- Modern tech stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL

## Target Users
- PG (Paying Guest) owners in India
- Hostel managers
- Co-living space operators
